description: Inspect, validate or register object and trait definitions. Use object_import instead to draft from existing schema files. Use it when exploring object shapes with list/show; use catalog_list instead to choose components, structured_data_fetch for complete datasets, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with definitions. Returns definitions, composed traits/view extensions, validation findings or registry write/reload results. action selects list/show/validate/register/reload. includeInternal reveals hidden objects. validate/register accept YAML; register writes your configured folder after checking declared contexts, and overwrite replaces your own definition. Team objects may shadow shipped objects; traits cannot reuse shipped names. Relationships validate their target and field. Reload reads folders without restarting. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#object_registry; full schema: oods://schemas/object_registry.input.json.

action.description: Selects the per-action contract: 'list' returns the objects in use with their source, business objects first and internal ones only with includeInternal, and every file not in use; 'show' returns the full composed… See full schema for details.

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline'). Actions: show.

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing'). Actions: list.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and hiddenInternal counts them. Actions: list.

maturity.description: Filter by metadata maturity level. Actions: list.

name.description: Object name to look up (e.g. 'User', 'Product', 'Invoice'). Actions: show (required).

overwrite.description: Replace a definition of yours with this name; without it a name you already registered is refused (OODS-C004). Actions: register.

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful'). Actions: list.

yaml.description: The whole definition as YAML: an object file starts with "object:", a trait file with "trait:" (the same format as OODS Foundry's own objects/ and traits/). Actions: validate (required), register (required). See full schema for details.

name: object_registry
title: Manage Object Registry
